paragraphs: Yose the child, son of Rabbi Zeaira of Kefar Ramin. The child spoke with Rabbi Yehudah and Rabbi Yitzchak; Rabbi Yehudah learned three things from his father. He was called Rabbi Yasa, the head of the hammer that breaks rocks. Zohar, Shemini, at the locators עש״ח and עע״א.
